title: Diamond Buying Guide for Engagement Rings
audience: Couples in their 30s, affluent, interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences beyond that, AUD 150k+ budget
notes: Fast mode: 02, 03 and 04 in parallel after the brief; 5 SERP cities; editor and readers in parallel; one combined final pass.

Scope: 4Cs and which matters most, shape, grading reports (GIA/IGI) and how to check them, natural vs lab-grown, ethics and origin (Kimberley Process and its limits), fluorescence, buying abroad or travelling with the stone, shortlist checklist.
Sources: GIA first; Kimberley Process; Australian consumer sources (ACCC) where relevant; Australian customs/Smartraveller for travel.
No prices, price-per-carat or 'spend X' rules (link the ring budget article). No jeweller names; GIA and IGI named as grading labs.
Firecrawl may be out of credits: fall back to DataForSEO on_page_instant_pages, Apify web-fetch or search summaries, and record which.
Person's standards: exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md; business details deferred.
